text:
Camille Ortega: Heads-up — Atlas QBR scheduled for Tue 4/12 9am PT. Need final deck + 3 exec asks by EOD Fri.
Ravi Shah: copying the onboarding health notes here. Renewal signal at 60% — usage dipped in March.
Morgan Lee: I can take the onboarding slide. Will pull adoption graphs and 3 friction bullets. ETA Thurs.
Sam Patel: I’ll own the exec asks slide. Need alignment on the top ask: pricing vs feature roadmap?
Diego Gomez: For renewal risk, ops reported two performance incidents last month — I’ll add a brief RCA summary and mitigation plan.
Camille Ortega: Good. Sam — recommend 1) commercial ask (renewal incentive), 2) product ask (SLA tweak), 3) enablement ask (team training). Keep each to one sentence.
Sam Patel: Got it. Can we make the commercial ask a 6-month credit + usage review? Ping @Ravi for numbers.
Ravi Shah: I’ll run a quick cohort analysis and drop numbers by tomorrow noon.
Morgan Lee: Quick Q: do we want a customer quote on adoption? I have a short snippet from their CSM call: "platform sped up our ingestion by ~2x".
Camille Ortega: Yes, include the quote as a pullout (one line). Helps execs.
ops-bot: Deploy report for atlas-prod: 2 incidents in March (03/05, 03/22). Mean recovery time 42m.
Diego Gomez: Adding mitigation: reserved dedicated capacity for peak windows + scheduled maintenance calendar.
Sam Patel: For the deck rundown — 1 slide health, 1 slide adoption + quote, 1 slide risk/mitigation, 1 slide ask (three bullets), 1 appendix with ops timeline.
Camille Ortega: Perfect. Owners: Morgan (slide 2), Diego (slide 3), Sam (slide 4), Ravi (appendix numbers). Me: cover lead-in and exec summary.
Ravi Shah: Action: I’ll add churn/usage table and projected renewal calc. Due: Fri 5pm PT.
Morgan Lee: Action: Add visuals + quote. Due: Thurs 11am PT.
Diego Gomez: Action: Draft mitigation timeline and SLO changes. Due: Thurs 3pm PT.
Sam Patel: Action: Draft the ask language + commercial proposal. Due: Fri 12pm PT.
Camille Ortega: Runbook — we’ll have a dry-run Mon 4/11 3pm PT. Please upload slides to the shared folder before the dry-run.
Ravi Shah: Uploaded initial numbers to Google Drive -> link.paste (I'll post link in thread).
Morgan Lee: Dropping the PNGs to the folder now.
Diego Gomez: Flag: If we propose credits, need legal + finance sign-off. I’ll loop them post-dry-run.
Camille Ortega: Noted. Final note — capture customer feedback items we promised to track and include in appendix (3 items). Morgan/Ravi, add those.
Sam Patel: Will capture meeting notes during QBR and push action-items to the renewal tracker.
Camille Ortega: Thanks team :thumbsup: — counting on everyone to hit their due dates so execs have a tight one-pager and clear asks.
